protocol.status: Fixed before new head fits or evaluation predictions
protocol.question: Does Gaussian-noise training of a linear classifier on frozen PANNs features transfer to recorded background interference?
protocol.target_task: Classify the designated ESC-50 foreground recording in an additive mixture; backgrounds may contain other events. This is not multi-label scene annotation.
protocol.encoder: Official frozen Cnn14_16k; eval mode; 2048-dimensional embedding
protocol.scaler: One StandardScaler fitted on clean training embeddings, fixed for both heads

training.augmentation: Zero-mean Gaussian noise added to waveform before frozen encoder; no clipping/peak normalization

evaluation.background_selection: Fixed metadata-based diversity: river, hallway, car. No listening-based eligibility claim and no prediction-based exclusions.
evaluation.mixture: Original target + zero-mean background scaled by full-window power ratio; no clipping or peak normalization
evaluation.silence_policy: Abort on zero/nonfinite target or background power; no score-based exclusion

protocol.primary: Adapted-minus-clean-refit accuracy, equal-weight average of the six recorded-background conditions within target, then clip-weighted mean over targets
secondary: 50-class macro-F1 per condition; average across conditions explicitly labelled
True-class margins and probability shifts, descriptive

bootstrap.noise_conditions: Fixed six segments; average differences per clip before source resampling
bootstrap.scope: Conditional on fixed heads, observed target sources and fixed backgrounds; no population-of-environments interval

protocol.decision: Report joint clean/noisy effects; no clean noninferiority margin supplied; no automatic default replacement or third fit
protocol.stop: Complete the fixed comparison; stop on input failure or nonconvergence before scientific interpretation; no score-driven changes
